aboutSubheading: Serving Langwarrin and the Mornington Peninsula since 2009
aboutText: With over 15 years of experience in appliance repair, Arrive On Time has become the trusted name for households across Langwarrin, Frankston, and the wider Mornington Peninsula. Our fully licensed and insured technicians service all major brands and carry common parts on every job. We built our reputation on one simple promise — we arrive on time, or the call-out fee is on us.

servicesSubheading: Professional repairs for all major home appliances across Melbourne's south-east
servicesText: From a leaking washing machine to a faulty oven, our skilled technicians handle it all. We service all major brands including Samsung, LG, Fisher & Paykel, Bosch, Miele, Electrolux, and more.

services.title: Washing Machine Repair
services.desc: Expert diagnosis and repair for front-loaders and top-loaders. We fix leaks, spin issues, drainage problems, and more — all major brands serviced.

services.title: Dishwasher Repair
services.desc: Is your dishwasher leaving dishes dirty or leaking on the floor? Our technicians quickly identify the fault and get it running like new again.

services.title: Dryer Repair
services.desc: Not heating up or taking too long to dry? We repair both vented and condenser dryers, replacing faulty elements, thermostats, and belts.

services.title: Electric Oven Repair
services.desc: Uneven cooking, no heat, or faulty temperature controls? Our team repairs electric ovens and wall ovens from all leading manufacturers.

services.title: Cooktop Repair
services.desc: From ceramic and induction to radiant cooktops, we fix faulty elements, broken touch controls, and power issues quickly and affordably.

services.title: Refrigerator Repair
services.desc: Keeping your food fresh is our priority. We repair fridges and freezers including cooling issues, compressor faults, and seal replacements.
